$comment: LandmarkLayer (M02d1; 02-world-bake.md section 7 rules 3 and 5). resident = most landmark models resident at once; swapM = distance inside which a landmark's model replaces its baked extrusion proxies. A resident landmark is released at swapM x unloadFactor (hysteresis, BD-M02d1-02). A failed load is tried again after retryMs. skyline (M02d2): the always-resident far silhouettes at the lo fidelity (02-world-bake.md section 7 rule 4); each is read when within loadFactor x the tier r2M (the building draw distance, config/world/streaming.json), put in the scene within mountFactor x r2M and parked beyond releaseFactor x r2M, so every skyline landmark inside r2M is up before it is needed; the skyline sits outside the per-tier resident caps (BD-M02d2-01).
